title: Compressor modulation 'On/off' is read as 'Modulating': the plan keeps sub-minimum steps
claim: With compressor_modulation=on_off and a 1.5 kW minimum saved through the thermal model page, 60 of 96 planned steps lie strictly between 0 and the minimum power, exactly as with 'modulating', although the option's description says on/off plans every step as off or between min and max power.
mechanism: thermal_model.declared_modulation returns True (modulating) for COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF ('True if mode == ON_OFF else True if mode == MODULATING'), contradicting its own docstring ('on_off -> False'); ThermalParameters.on_off = declared_modulation(cfg) is False is therefore never set by the user's choice.

evidence.unit: planned steps (of 96) with 0.01 kW < power < min power under on_off

perturbation.change: --perturb-docstring: declared_modulation returns False for on_off, as its docstring states

metric_definition: count of data['schedule'][i]['power'] with 0.01 < p < heat_pump_min_power after saving on_off + min 1.5 kW, restart, one cycle
phenomenon_property: Each value of the compressor_modulation option maps to the model's on/off flag as its description says: on_off -> on/off planning, modulating -> modulating, auto -> the probe.
seam_rule: grep -n 'declared_modulation(' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py (its three readers: ThermalParameters on_off and the two probe sites at thermal_model.py:1570 and :1633)

null_control.note: sub-minimum averaged steps are documented for modulating; on_off is identical to it

reproduction_steps: Options > Advanced > Thermal model: Min power 1.5, Compressor modulation On/off; save
data['schedule'] holds 60 steps between 0 and 1.5 kW
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.declared_modulation: on_off -> False; failing test through the options page on the planned levels, null control modulating; the two probe sites re-checked.
